message.content:
The structure is described in space group number 65, symbol Cmmm, with Hall symbol [[param:space_group.hall]]. The input cell is primitive in shape but C-centered in the standard setting, with lattice parameters a = [[param:cell.a]] Å, b = [[param:cell.b]] Å, c = [[param:cell.c]] Å, α = [[param:cell.alpha]]°, β = [[param:cell.beta]]°, and γ = [[param:cell.gamma]]°. The input composition contains [[param:composition.Er]], [[param:composition.Co]], and [[param:composition.Si]], totaling [[param:input.atom_count]] atoms.

The standard crystallographic frame is obtained from the input frame by the basis transformation matrix [[param:frame.matrix]] together with the origin shift [[param:frame.origin_shift]]. In this standard setting, the structure is described by five independent Wyckoff orbits. The Er atoms occupy orbit [[param:orbit.o000.id]], labeled [[param:orbit.o000.wyckoff]], with one free positional parameter [[param:orbit.o000.parameters]] along the y direction at fixed x = 0 and z = 1/2. The Co atoms occupy orbit [[param:orbit.o001.id]], labeled [[param:orbit.o001.wyckoff]], with free parameter [[param:orbit.o001.parameters]] along y at fixed x = 0 and z = 0.

Three distinct Si orbits are present. The first, [[param:orbit.o002.id]], is labeled [[param:orbit.o002.wyckoff]] and has free parameter [[param:orbit.o002.parameters]] along y at fixed x = 0 and z = 1/2. The second, [[param:orbit.o003.id]], is labeled [[param:orbit.o003.wyckoff]] with free parameter [[param:orbit.o003.parameters]] along y at fixed x = 0 and z = 0. The third, [[param:orbit.o004.id]], is labeled [[param:orbit.o004.wyckoff]] with free parameter [[param:orbit.o004.parameters]] along y at fixed x = 0 and z = 0.

All five orbits have multiplicity 4, so the full structure contains 4 Er, 4 Co, and 12 Si atoms per conventional C-centered cell. The positional parameters were rounded to [[param:round_digits]] decimal places in the input fractional coordinates. No precision corrections beyond this rounding were applied to the idealized backbone.
